ask_title: Not in the shop right now?
ask_text: I only list pieces I have actually made, so a glaze sells out from time to time. Tell me what you are after in {glaze} and I will make it and set it aside for you. A commission works the same way: rough dimensions and the glaze line are enough to start.

ask_image.alt: Matthew Freed at the wheel, the batch he has just thrown drying beside him
